name: apple-minimal-ui
content: Use a minimal color palette with plenty of whitespace. Focus on typography and subtle shadows. Rounded corners should be consistent (e.g., 12px or 16px). Use system fonts like San Francisco or Inter.

name: custom-hover-effects
description: Smooth, physics-based hover states for interactive elements
content: Implement hover effects using CSS transitions or spring animations. Scale up slightly (1.02x) and increase shadow depth. Ensure transitions are smooth (approx 200ms-300ms ease-out).

name: clean-navbar
description: Responsive, accessible navigation bar with blur effects
content: Create a sticky navbar with a backdrop-filter blur. Use a flexbox layout for links. Ensure mobile responsiveness with a hamburger menu. maintain high contrast for accessibility.
